why: Third tests round for pipe plumbing in next/, after the build. L14 now holds the reader still the way the runtime does: the reader crashes on a crash letter and its own supervisor holds the successor for an 8 s backoff, so letters 1 and 2 land, letter 3 answers full and is not saved, and once the runtime starts the successor, which reads and acks, a resend of letter 3 lands. Calls from outside could not do it: the Project's exit is not followed by a restart (a second first start and a trusted restart of the ended process both answer unreachable). Mail.test's document helper now types its value as TomlDocument's. Every plant ran on the real build. Five stayed green and each was a hole or a wrong plant: L7 ledger with min(pos) (the law asserted inside the ledger turn, where a failed expect became the turn's own failure and was counted as a refused append; it now judges after the turn and must reach a stream with several entries), L6's cap-before-receipt (the planted spot was the in-turn recheck; the real early receipt read is outside the turn, and a plant there turns L6 red), a lost ack failing the turn (L10 now needs the reader's turn to answer when its ack is lost), and a mail Cmd waiting behind an owed send_chunks to any name (a new L11 law with a second reader: a letter to another name lands while a chunked send waits, and a letter to the same name waits). A mail Cmd waiting behind an owed plain send too stays green: it keeps the plan's order per pair, so no law in the plan tells it apart, left to the lead.
